metaDescription: Get to know VeloCT: who we are, our vision, and the team behind technology solutions for your business.
heading: About Us
description: PT Velo Citra Teknologi is a legally registered AI and data consulting company in Indonesia. We help government agencies and industry put infrastructure, data, and AI to real use.
heroImageAlt: PT Velo Citra Teknologi team photo
visionText: Trusted AI & Data Expert Consulting Company — <yellow>built</yellow> to <red>give government</red> and <red>industry</red> the leverage they need to build a <green>better Indonesia.</green>
missionItems: Build the infrastructure and data foundation first, so the AI that runs on it can be relied on.
Prepare historical data that is ready for decisions, with personal data protection and data sovereignty.
Manage clients' AWS cloud so their systems stay reliable, secure, and cost-controlled.
Stay with clients until the system is used every day and its benefits are felt.
nameText: The name VeloCT comes from velocity: faster decisions because the data is ready.
logoText: The three lines of the logo form a zebra crossing. Its colours come from Edward de Bono's Six Thinking Hats and read in order:

values.title: Honest about capability
values.text: We only claim what we have done and can prove.

values.title: Client data belongs to the client
values.text: Access, ownership, and exit rights are clear from the start.

values.title: No surprises
values.text: Cost, scope, and partner roles are agreed in writing up front.

values.title: Proven before the trendy
values.text: New technology is used once it is proven to solve the client's problem.

valuesBannerText: AI is built once the data and infrastructure are ready.
